title: They were promised protection. Instead, these kids with disabilities died in foster care
description: Disabled kids make up the largest group in foster care. They have the worst outcomes. They stay in foster care longest. They're the most likely to die.
text:
Disabled kids make up the largest group in foster care. They stay in foster care longest. The small ranch house, lit up from inside in the dark, desert night, is a residential treatment facility for seven young men in foster care.

The facility provided specialized mental health care for Christian, who, in the one month since he'd come to the group home, was in and out of the hospital for complications from his Type 1 diabetes. I don't know anything about that," the woman who called the police, a staffer at the foster care home, tells an officer, recorded on the officer's body camera. An NPR investigation, including an analysis of federal data on hundreds of thousands of children, shows that kids with disabilities are the largest group that go into foster care.
